fit_and_pseudo.pseudo_probe: Independent deterministic stress probe, not an advertised repository workflow: ceil(actual rendered cells * 1.30).
fit_and_pseudo.pseudo_disposition: Fit-risk evidence for the separate rendered gate; pseudo overflow alone is not counted as a translation defect when the actual Urdu fits.
fit_and_pseudo.materially_longer_disposition: 25 have no declared maxCells and are retained for rendered fit review; tui.asks.dismiss.notice_no_reply has maxCells=44 and measures 39 cells, so it fits; length alone is not counted as a defect

native_semantics_register_glossary.formality: آپ and respectful imperatives are used; no تم address and no direct تو address were found in the complete read. تو occurs as the ordinary conjunction then.
native_semantics_register_glossary.glossary: Shared session/wake/agent/subagent/tool/transcript/workspace/approval/project/model/prompt/compaction/schedule/monitor terms were checked. Drift and unendorsed Latin prose are findings, not silently accepted.
native_semantics_register_glossary.allowed_english: Local Operator, lop/lo, omp/oh-my-pi, tool and command names, flags, config keys, paths, identifiers, URLs, event/machine tokens, official technology/product names, kept-Latin acronyms, enum/command syntax where the UI requires it, and the sidecar-required product noun Scratchpad.
native_semantics_register_glossary.english_leakage_result: Failed in wire.settings, wire.slash, tui.welcome, wire.remote_compute, and wire.errors.settings; narrower script drift is recorded in cli.exec_remote_help.

typography_rtl_static.rendered_rtl_evidence: NOT PERFORMED and NOT CLAIMED. Native bidi/shaping, RTL layout, punctuation rendering, and rendered fallback/long-text evidence remain a separate gate.
